algorithm.hintTable: Use each support card's literal published hint list exactly once; alternate/version IDs do not create additional hint opportunities.
algorithm.hintValue: Compute course-specific horse-length per effective skill point, then raise that efficiency to 0.65. There is no additional independent raw-length exponent in the fitted live model.
algorithm.tableQuality: Divide the summed usable hint utility by literal hint-table size^1.10.
algorithm.hintFrequency: Multiply hint-table score by (1 + Hint Frequency Up / 100)^0.60.
algorithm.deckOverlap: Multiply contributions already represented by literal hints in the selected main deck by 0.80.
algorithm.events: Use exact GameTora support-event topology. For each event, evaluate mutually-exclusive choices, keep the highest-value choice, and add 0.015 times its summed utility.
algorithm.eventHints: Use the exact granted skill ID and event-granted hint level when computing skill-point efficiency.
algorithm.scale: Multiply the combined raw score by 62.795762 to match the current U-tools score scale.

provenance.liveTargetTransport: Jina-rendered current U-tools factor pages keyed by support ID
provenance.liveHintLevelAudit: 80/80 displayed Lv values matched card Hint Lv Up
